ai_ack_required: Confirm the warnings (GDPR, hallucinations, prompt injection) first.
ai_disabled: AI access is disabled in the panel (Administration → AI access).
ai_not_allowed: The AI policy does not allow this request (tool disabled or outside the AI tool list).
ai_range: The query period exceeds the AI policy limit.
ai_unavailable: AI access is not available in this configuration.
alerts_disabled: The alerts module is disabled in the siem-api configuration.
alias_chain: This would create a chain of aliases – point to the person, not to another alias.
already_enrolled: This account already has a second factor.
anchor_disabled: The archive anchor is disabled in the configuration.
archive_disabled: The archive view is disabled in the siem-api configuration.
archive_not_configured: The archiver has not run yet.
assistant_alert_denied: The assistant cannot read the alert (permissions or AI policy).
assistant_busy: The AI assistant is busy with other questions – try again in a moment.
assistant_disabled: The AI assistant is disabled (Administration → AI access).
assistant_incident_denied: The assistant cannot read the incident (permissions or AI policy – the “incidents” group)
assistant_limit: Daily limit of AI assistant questions used up.
assistant_session_only: The AI assistant works only in the panel (analyst session).
assistant_unreachable: The model endpoint is unreachable or returned an error.
auto_update_off: The agent's group does not have automatic updates enabled.
backup_disabled: Backups are disabled in the siem-api configuration.
bad_account: Invalid account name (name only, e.g. admin, root).
bad_agents: At most 100 agents in a single request.
bad_alias: Provide an account name and a person (they must differ).
bad_aware_at: The moment of becoming aware of the incident cannot be in the future.
bad_credentials: Invalid username or password, or the account is temporarily locked.
bad_display_name: The display name is too long.
bad_identity: Invalid agent identifier in the certificate.
bad_ids: Invalid selection – too few or too many items.
bad_mapping: Invalid group mapping: group without a SID or unknown profile.
bad_mfa: Invalid code – check the time on your phone and try again.
bad_pseudonym: A pseudonym looks like USER-7F3A12BC, HOST-…, IP-…, EMAIL-….
bad_reason: Provide a reason – it will be recorded in the audit log.
bad_resolution: Resolution (when closing): true_positive, benign or false_positive.
bad_severity: Severity: low, medium, high or critical.
bad_token: The token is invalid (expired, revoked or used up).
bad_token_name: Token name: 2–64 characters – letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore.
bad_transition: This status change is not allowed.
bad_username: Username: 2–64 characters – letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore.
bad_validity: Token validity: from 1 hour to 90 days.
builtin: A built-in profile cannot be changed – copy it as a new one.
busy: Another job is running – try again in a moment.
ca_missing: The server CA certificate is not available in this configuration.
change_closed: The change has already taken effect or was closed.
close_summary: Closing requires a summary (at least 10 characters).
closed: The incident is closed – read only.
confirm_required: Type the confirmation word to continue.
csrf: Missing or invalid CSRF token – reload the page.
decoders_disabled: Decoders are disabled in the siem-api configuration.
duplicate_id: This rule ID is already in use.
enroll_disabled: Agent enrolment is disabled – the agents CA is missing.
enroll_first: First enable a second factor on your own account (My account → Security) – otherwise the panel would sign you out too.
enroll_required: First set up the authenticator app.
events_disabled: Event search is disabled – no ClickHouse connection.
exists: An item with this name already exists.
export_missing: The export file is unavailable (removed after expiry?).
export_not_ready: The export is not ready for download yet.
exports_disabled: Export downloads are disabled – SIEM_ARCHIVE_EXPORT_DIR is not set in siem-api.
final_report_missing: A significant (NIS2) incident can be closed only after the final report is marked as submitted.
forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
identities_disabled: Identities are disabled in the siem-api configuration.
in_use: The item is in use and cannot be deleted.
incidents_disabled: Incidents are unavailable in this configuration.
internal: Server error – details in the siem-api log.
invalid_token: Invalid, expired or revoked API token.
last_admin: After this change no active account would be able to manage the panel.
ldap_account: For domain accounts this is managed in Active Directory.
ldap_disabled: Domain sign-in is unavailable – it requires an encryption key on the server (certs/mfa.key).
ldap_unavailable: The domain controller is unavailable – try again later or use a local account.
mcp_ai_token_only: The MCP server accepts only an API token of kind AI.
mcp_missing: The vardr-mcp.exe program is not on the server (deploy.sh tools or the installation bundle).
method_not_allowed: This method is not allowed here.
mfa_disabled: The second sign-in factor is not available on this server.
mfa_expired: Sign-in expired – enter your username and password again.
mfa_not_enabled: This account has no second factor.
mfa_required: The panel requires a second sign-in factor – sign in again.
mfa_required_by_policy: The panel policy requires a second factor for this account.
msi_patch_failed: The installer could not be prepared – rebuild the agent.
nats_disabled: The panel is not connected to NATS – reprocessing is unavailable.
no_access: This domain account has no access to the panel – it is not a member of any group mapped to a profile.
no_agent_exe: The agent program is missing on the server (SIEM_AGENT_EXE).
no_agent_msi: The agent MSI installer is missing on the server.
no_backup: No such backup on the list – refresh the list.
no_change: The policy is already set this way – nothing to change.
no_channel: No enabled channel receives the archive anchor.
no_client_cert: A valid agent certificate is required.
no_exceptions: Exceptions are available for deployed Sigma rules (not correlations or built-in rules).
no_manifest: The backup has no valid manifest.
no_samples: Add samples to the definition – example messages the decoder recognises (for tests and documentation).
no_trial: Trial mode is available for Sigma rules only (not correlations or built-in rules).
no_unknown: The last verification reported no unknown files.
not_a_token: This request is for programs with an API token.
not_configured: Detection is not configured (siem-detector has not run).
not_signable: Message signing is available for webhook and Power Automate / Teams channels.
not_switchable: This rule cannot be switched from the panel.
notify_disabled: Notifications are disabled in the siem-api configuration.
oidc_disabled: SSO sign-in is unavailable – it needs the encryption key on the server (certs/mfa.key).
pending: Such a job is already waiting to run.
profiles_disabled: Permission profiles are unavailable in this configuration.
quarantine_disabled: Quarantine is unavailable (event search is disabled in the siem-api configuration).
rate_limited: Too many attempts – wait a moment and try again.
reauth_failed: The password is incorrect or the account is temporarily locked.
reauth_required: This change weakens protection – confirm it with your password.
reauth_sso: Confirm your identity by signing in again with Entra ID.
revoked: The agent certificate has been revoked.
rules_disabled: Rule management is disabled in the siem-api configuration.
runner_missing: The backup service (siem-backup) has not reported yet – the secret cannot be stored safely without its key.
self: You cannot disable your own account.
settings_disabled: Settings are unavailable in this configuration.
sso_account: An SSO account has no password in the panel – its password and profile come from Entra ID.
submitted: The report has already been submitted – its content is frozen.
timeout: The query took too long – narrow the time range or add filters.
token_name_taken: An active token with this name already exists.
token_not_allowed: This operation is available only after signing in to the panel.
tokens_disabled: API tokens are not available in this configuration.
totp_first: Enable the authenticator app (TOTP) first – it stays as the fallback.
unauthenticated: Your session has expired – sign in again.
username_taken: The domain account username is taken by a local panel account – an administrator must rename one of them.
weak_password: The new password is too weak or the same as the current one.
webauthn_exists: This security key is already registered (or the key limit was reached).
webauthn_invalid: The security key's response is invalid.
webauthn_limit: The account has reached the limit of security keys – remove one you no longer use.
webauthn_needs_name: Security keys need the panel opened by its name (not an IP address) over HTTPS.
webauthn_no_challenge: Start signing in with the security key again.
webauthn_no_keys: The account has no security key for this panel address – use a code.
